University Tour

Experience Our Campus Firsthand!

Are you considering studying at the University of Groningen? Do you want to get a real feel for our campus, explore our facilities, and experience student life up close?

We invite you to join one of our centrally organized University Tours! While we highly recommend visiting during an Open Day for a fully immersive experience, we understand that this might not always fit your schedule. That’s why we offer guided campus tours on specific dates throughout the year.

During the tour, you’ll explore key locations on campus, learn more about studying at the University of Groningen, and have the opportunity to ask questions about student life, housing, and academics.

Interested? Sign up now and let us show you around!
